plan: The public prototype is static, uses only local resources, and renders a fixed dataset as text. The approved plan explicitly asks the security review to capture a restrictive Content Security Policy as deferred hardening; there is no policy requirement for this milestone or evidence of an injection path.

Allow signed-in customers to download their own invoices. Invoice identifiers are visible in forwarded emails. requireSession sets the verified account ID. sendFile serves the named PDF. The shown storage helper uses exact matches on any provided fields.

Make support attachments available by ticket ID. The permission layer runs on every request and checks that the caller can see the ticket. Ticket participants can upload multiple attachments to their own tickets. Attachment IDs are UUIDs disclosed in support emails. The storage adapter scopes by every field passed to findAttachment.

Show a default avatar when the client receives an unknown animal key. The API response may contain arbitrary keys. These three icon files are checked-in static assets. Local builds serve these assets with no separate external origin.
